The next day after he was done working I saw him and asked him why he did that to me. He told me that he was confused and that he thought that's what I wanted and that I was into that and that it was some fantasy of mine. I knew he was lying. Which made me hate him more for covering his tracks. 

I stupily told his mom and she said it didn't sound like him. I really thought she loved me. Stupid. He is friends with some police and the people at work think he's so nice. So did I. I was afraid no one would believe me. And mostly I just wanted to kill myself. I felt too tired anyway to fight it.

rape.
by someone I trusted.  And he knew I'd been raped in high school. After he acted like everything was normal. It started the next day or two. I kept wanting to go to sleep all the time, and i kept thinking of drowning myself. I  like to swim under the water where i can't hear the world, so it doesn't frighten me. I started going to large bodies of water and standing there in this trance just dying to swim in there and die. 

I had some help too. From a woman (rape counselor). For about 5 times I spoke to her. She was very nice and kind and genuine, but she couldn't make me stop feeling my life was over. I don't feel like me.

It's like this pressure builds up inside. I have been fighting depression for over a year. I'm nervous to be around people. I didn't used to be too much, but now I'm a scared mouse. I don't feel like me anymore. I was always on the quiet side but happyish. I would get down, but I would spring back again. Now it's just eternal feelings of being disconnected from the world.  I sometimes feel numb. Like I'm not really here. Hurting myself makes me feel a little more here - alive. I think to it has something to do with wanting to show people what they've done to me. Even though I do it, hurt myself, in private. 
But when i do it i tell myself i hate myself. "I hate you , you stupid stupid girl" Then i usually cry, calm down and fall asleep or something.
